title: Why We Call It a Deadline
short_teaser: The word deadline once referred to a literal boundary that could not be crossed, especially in prison settings.
story: The word deadline once referred to a literal boundary that could not be crossed, especially in prison settings. Over time it became a term for a time limit. Words can carry the emotional weight of their history long after the original setting disappears. Words shape what we notice and remember. Naming an experience can make it easier to understand, share, and use. The lasting value is not merely knowing the fact. It is seeing the pattern beneath it and considering where that same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
